objective: bounded engineering pilot of actual OCR and ASR feeding the fixed known-item index; no retraining or condition tuning

ocr.samples: 20 previously frozen couplet IDs, 4 per author
ocr.engine: tesserocr2.12.0 bundled Tesseract + official tessdata_fast fas
ocr.render: Windows Tahoma at size36, width1600; shrink font deterministically if text width>1520, minimum20; two right-aligned source verses, reshaped/bidi if raqm unavailable; canonical text without author masking
ocr.reference: programmatic canonical source text, not human-labelled photographs

asr.candidate_selection: lowest numeric poem ID per author among the 20 frozen IDs; choose smallest recitation numeric ID with inSyncWithText true, no listed mistakes, mp3<=2MiB. If missing metadata/timing then log a skip, never replace after transcription outcomes.
asr.segment: Use official /api/audio/verses/{recitation_id} audioStartMilliseconds timestamps directly (legacy XML offset ambiguity avoided). Frozen query couplet from its first verse start through next verse after couplet start, with 0.25s margins; duration <=60s. No boundary tuning after ASR.
asr.engine: vosk0.3.45, official vosk-model-small-fa-0.42, CPU, no constrained grammar or hints
asr.references: source poem and upstream per-verse timing; upstream alignment not independently human verified; exploratory results only

limits: Rendered OCR is synthetic imagery; small audio pilot is not a held-out ASR benchmark and may contain upstream alignment mismatch. Text classification and retrieval frozen results are preserved.
scope: local-only raw images/audio/weights/runtime; export code, hashes, IDs and aggregate outcomes only
pre_execution_clarification: Official public Swagger and per-verse API inspected before engine output; legacy XML is archived but is not used for timing.
